input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
input.rationale: The only cap in the Agreement (§12, p0077) is one-sided: it limits TrueLink's liability alone, and only for matters under Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11, while Client's liability — including its very broad indemnity in §12a — is entirely uncapped. That is walk-away territory under the rule (Customer uncapped while Vendor capped) and fails the fallback element of a mutual aggregate cap. No exclusion of indirect/consequential damages exists anywhere in the document, and no other liability-limiting language was found (§8, §9, §10 and §12 all checked). We therefore target the fallback: the existing 12-month compensation basis is retained verbatim, the cap is made mutual and aggregate across the Agreement, and indemnification obligations, breach of confidentiality obligations (§10), gross negligence and willful misconduct sit outside the cap for both parties. Preferred extras (USD 1,000,000 floor, mutual consequential-damages exclusion, data protection/fraud/IP carve-outs, payment-obligation exclusion) are noted as available upgrades but not required at this level.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
mappings.quote: EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.

mappings.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.

proposal.summary: Make the 12-month fee cap mutual and aggregate, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct outside the cap.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is a mutual aggregate cap at 12 months' fees, so we made the existing TrueLink-only cap apply to both parties and to the Agreement as a whole (Client is presently uncapped), keeping the 12-month compensation basis unchanged. Indemnification and confidentiality breaches, gross negligence and willful misconduct sit outside the cap for both parties.
